name: adjacencyMatrix
notes: MathTS requires explicit n and uses boolean directed param; mathjs auto-detects n and accepts options object with undirected flag.

name: connectedComponents
notes: MathTS takes adjacency matrix (number[][]); mathjs takes adjacency list object, so input format is fundamentally different.

name: graphDistance
notes: MathTS takes adjacency matrix with numeric node indices; mathjs takes weighted adjacency list object supporting string or number nodes.

name: isConnected
notes: MathTS takes adjacency matrix (number[][]); mathjs takes adjacency list object, so input format is fundamentally different.

name: minimumSpanningTree
notes: MathTS uses Prim's algorithm on adjacency matrix; mathjs uses Kruskal's algorithm on an edge list with explicit n parameter.

name: stronglyConnectedComponents
notes: MathTS takes adjacency matrix with integer node indices; mathjs takes adjacency list object supporting string or number node keys.

name: topologicalSort
notes: MathTS takes adjacency matrix returning integer indices; mathjs takes adjacency list object and preserves original node types in output.
